hints.title: Hierarchical Date Comparison
hints.text: Compare dates starting with the year, then the month, then the day.

hints.title: Multi-tier Fine Rules
hints.text: Apply the fixed year fine if returned in a later year, or scale by month/day if within the same period.

hints.title: Early Return Zeroing
hints.text: Ensure that returns on or before the due date incur zero penalty.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct constant-time conditional comparison of date triplets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Structure conditional branches from largest unit (year) to smallest (day).
